answers.core: Tileset management is largely provided in-core, and it probably makes sense to keep this in-core. I am willing to accept a third-party script or tool that can do this, although that tool would need to be kept up-to-date whenever the tileset file structure or format changes.
answers.workaround: It's possible to manually merge tilesets within Godot, although this requires creating one of them within the other one. It's tedious and error prone; the copy/paste bitmask tool helps a lot.
